        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a, a1, a2, b, x, y, i, n;
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        double d = (double) x / y;
        double ans = 1e7;
        double eps = 1e-25;
        a = 1;
        b = 1;

        if (y <= b) {
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            return;
        }

        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a1 = (long) Math.floor(d * i);
            a2 = (long) Math.ceil(d * i);

            if (Math.abs(d - (double) a1 / i) < ans - eps) {
                ans = Math.abs(d - (double) a1 / i);
                a = a1;
                b = i;
            }

            if (Math.abs((double) a2 / i - d) < ans - eps) {
                ans = Math.abs((double) a2 / i - d);
                a = a2;
                b = i;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
    }
}
